title: vernonia greggii subsp. schaffneri
intro: Vernonia greggii subsp. schaffneri, commonly known as Schaffner's ironweed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Schaffner's ironweed include pain relief, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
